correctness.contract: checker authoritative; exact parent output bytes where the parent passes the checker; where the parent fails it, a checker pass (improvement) or the exact parent behaviour (no regression); exact parent error identity on malformed cases; input unchanged (trusted runtime guard)

method.aggregate: equal-weight geometric mean of per-workload median candidate/parent ratios
method.interval: seeded paired bootstrap over pairs within each workload
method.timing: per-process wall / batch iterations (startup, imports, validation, serialization and input guard included; checker excluded)

protocol.aggregate: equal-weight geometric mean of per-workload median candidate/parent ratios
protocol.candidate_review: reject cross-invocation result memoization, persistent state in dependencies/builtins and mutations of frozen dependencies; unchanged independent runtime isolation still applies
protocol.claim_requires: amortized protected full-execution batch gain >= minimum; paired bootstrap upper ratio <= 0.90; every workload protected wall median ratio <= 1.05; all correctness cases pass
protocol.correctness: all valid exact output bytes plus original immutable checks; all malformed exact parent error type, code and message; input unchanged
protocol.invocation_state: fresh JSON packet and fresh candidate module namespace each invocation; candidate compiled once inside protected wall; immutable dependency imports shared
protocol.process_scope: original single-invocation protected latency remains separately reported; no claim of pure execute latency reduction
protocol.qualification: local development evidence only; security deferred; no admission or activation
protocol.timing_scope: authoritative protected process wall divided by fixed full-execution batch size; includes startup, imports, packet validation, copy, serialization and input guard; checker excluded

qualification: local development evidence only; security deferred; no admission or activation
